scope: Fixed-work research on two reused seasons and two common starts, with paired numerical repetitions; restricted no-Assistant-Manager action space in 2024/25

resource_amendment.scope: Resource-only probe-cap amendment before new season scoring; no point-result selection
resource_amendment.rule: Choose the largest cap from 12, 8, 6 for which 38 times the largest per-policy mean preflight time times cap/12 fits the existing 900-second path guard. Linear scaling is a resource estimate, not a guarantee or football criterion.
resource_amendment.required_validation: Fresh uniform 24-case source-only preflight with the selected cap before the full 24-season-path matrix; retain the original 24-case pilot and both failed preflights.
resource_amendment.chip_fairness: Reserve capacity for one combined-schedule proposal when the fixed-work cap is 6–9; probe each eligible chip family before later dates. Duplicate schedules reuse the cache. Legacy wall-time behaviour is unchanged.
resource_amendment.limitations: Fixed-work search may cost more than timed search; cap changes define a separate research policy. No promise of global optimality, identical CPU work or equal scores versus PR40.

wrapper_compatibility_repair.failure: SciPy maps HiGHS enum16 solution-limit to status4; wrapper warned parallel string off is rejected and defaulted
wrapper_compatibility_repair.repair: Boolean parallel=False; fatal OptimizeWarning; explicit node mode maps only exact HiGHS enum16 message while preserving all incumbent checks/raw status

resume_protocol.reason: One inner time safety guard fired while the host entered lid-closed sleep, then woke about eighteen minutes later. The failed batch stopped after ten complete paths and seventeen settled origins of the eleventh.
resume_protocol.preservation: Retain the original failed batch and all partial decisions unchanged. Reference the ten checksum-verified completed paths without copying or changing them.
resume_protocol.action: One identical retry of the interrupted case, followed by the thirteen as-yet-unrun matrix cases. No numerical source, input, rule, node/probe/seed/thread setting or resource limit changes. Stop on any further failure.
resume_protocol.integrity: Before accepting the retry, require its first seventeen full-plan/financial/source fingerprints to match the saved interrupted prefix. All twenty-four declared completed paths and both numerical repetitions remain mandatory.
resume_protocol.claim_limit: The failed safety-limited attempt is not a successful fixed-work run; it and its costs remain separate from the completed matrix. Host-sleep coincidence is evidence for the operational interruption, not proof that a given node budget always finishes within a time limit.

search_quality.scope: Selected-schedule bounds certify only their declared restricted mean objective. Decision reranking expected bounds and global chip/season bounds are unknown. Candidate fallbacks are counted across all probes, not inferred to be the selected candidate.

The fixed-work six-probe controls differ from earlier timed twelve-probe policies; do not attribute cross-study score differences solely to timing
Node caps do not bound root/presolve effort or equalise CPU work across different formulations and HiGHS versions

Named adapted Solio core under shared forecasts and research chip policy, not an original complete manager

Weights, normal weekly defaults and manual sensitivities remain unchanged; no live planning or account action
